en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibrahim Bin Abdul Hameed, from Sukeyn, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> used to eat the honey and he<sup>saww</sup> was saying: ‘A Verse from the Quran and chewing the frankincense melts the phlegm’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ja‘far from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ibrahim from ‘Abd Allah al-Hamid from Sukayn who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, would (say)
eating honey, reciting verses of Quran and chewing frankincense dissolve phlegm.’”
